name: SSH Upload
description: Upload pasted or dropped files in remote conversations and SSH workspace projects. Uses read-only project/get to keep uploads inside the remote workspace. Key authentication only.

en.name: SSH Upload
en.description: Upload pasted or dropped files in SSH projects and remote conversations. Reads project metadata through desktop control; no passwords stored.

zh-CN.name: SSH 文件上传
zh-CN.description: 支持 SSH 项目与远程会话中的文件拖拽、粘贴上传；通过桌面控制接口只读查询项目，自动放入远程工作区。本机会话不接管，不保存密码。
